text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to check on Mejiro Dober, who 
sustained an injury during training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Did you come all the way here just to 
check on me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... You really could have just left 
me alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't have to worry about it. 
Just think of it as a slightly longer 
interval.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't hurt that much, and honestly, 
having you worry over me like this makes 
me feel even more restless...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't hurt that much, and honestly, 
having you worry over me like this makes 
me feel even more restless...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll head back to training after resting a 
bit more. Go on ahead.
choice_data_list: First, let's get plenty of rest.

You're not pushing yourself too hard……are 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I figured you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I do something reckless and make it 
worse, they'll just worry even more and 
stay over even longer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know you're worried about me, but 
still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Got it. I'll behave myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Got it. I'll behave myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober rested quietly, ruminating on 
her frustration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you exaggerating a bit? It's really 
no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, I can't let myself stop at this 
level...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Tsk... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I-I'm fine. ...Guess it's too late 
to say that... Ouch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed moving it was still out of the 
question. Mejiro Dober looked visibly 
dejected.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after leaving the nurse's 
office, Mejiro Dober catches up to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness, looks like the pain has 
subsided. I should have no problem moving 
around now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get started. I need to make 
up for the time I rested.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The injury had minimal impact, and Mejiro 
Dober was able to resume training at a 
safe pace!
